proved_claims.statement: If s3(A)>=1 and A=[[a,b^T],[b,C]] with a!=0, S=C-bb^T/a and K=||b||/|a|, then s2(S)>=(1+K)^(-2).

If the entire-range frame of symmetric S has maximum row leverage <=1/32 and S has two singular values >=tau, then Y^TSY has an L3 density with norm <=[16 K0 e/(7 sqrt(2) tau)]^(2/3), K0=sqrt(pi)Gamma(1/4)/Gamma(3/4).

Under s3(A)>=1, a nonzero original-coordinate pivot with ratio K=||offrow||/|a| and a Schur residual whose entire-range leverage is <=1/32 yields ||p_Q||infinity <=16(1+K)|a|^(-1/2)sqrt[K0 e/(7sqrt(2))]. Arbitrary additional spectral directions are retained.
If P=1_{|A|>=1}, P_ii>=1/64, ||A_i,-i||<=|A_ii|, and the Schur residual is entire-range diffuse, then ||p_Q||infinity<Cstar with Cstar=129.1603760263356<130.

partner_results_applied.application: In a product-preserving cross-dominated extraction retaining fraction theta of the pivot cross-row norm and effective square strength kappa, the density obeys ||p_Q||infinity<2^(9/2)/sqrt(theta kappa).
For one conditioned full-range row with leverage h_i<=1/2 and residual raw row leverages <=(1-h_i)/32, the law has a continuous density <=96e/[7sqrt(2)(1-h_i)]<54.

dependencies.used_for: MSS physical partition, leverage-safe q=1 determinant Fourier estimate, arbitrary additional small-spectrum tolerance.

fresh_residual.statement: Within the B19 low-stable-rank residual, either obtain a uniform product-preserving aggregate hyperbolic-square extraction from cross-dominated large-spectral rows, or control the finite heavy-coordinate/near-singular residual spectral-Gram localization without losing a large spectral direction. The branch where all large-spectral projection leverages are <1/64 remains separately unpaid.

continuity_status: The main pivot-square branch proves essential boundedness only. The fresh conditioned-whitened partner branch proves a bounded continuous density. Full-target continuity remains open.
